title: Add playlist tab to main page

timeline.body:
#### What is it? - [ ] Bug fix (user facing) - [x] Feature (user facing) - [ ] Code base improvement (dev facing) - [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing) #### Description of the changes in your PR Add bookmarked playlist as tab in the main page (by Settings > Content > Content of main page)
#### Fixes the following issue(s) - fixes #3210 - fixes #1781 #### Testing apk [NewPipe_PlaylistTab-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/4561449/NewPipe_PlaylistTab-debug.zip) #### Agreement - [x] I carefully read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.
Just do `.subscribe(this::displayPlaylists, this::onError)` (I didn't test that). You should also store the `Disposable` it returns and dispose it in `onDestroy()`.
There's a typo here (and in other places), it should be `OnSelectedListener`
Please end with a newline (that's why we need #3394, so that your IDE would do that automatically…)

timeline.body: I did a quick code review, so I didn't really look in detail. There are also some more variables that could be `final`. I think you should use the bookmark icon though.
You should use a string resource here, maybe other languages use different signatures than "S/P" to express "playlist P comes from service S"

reply.body: Also, is there really a need to show the service name? This is not being done with channels afaik

@Stypox: It's actually done the same way for channels, so this is OK here. See https://github.com/Royosef/NewPipe/blob/8f99a3b7b583a9cee2bc8e7cb9839dec251885c9/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/settings/tabs/ChooseTabsFragment.java#L416
